patch_description:
The current program underperforms compared to the first prior (0.55 vs 0.58) because:
1. Missing the RZ mid-layer reduces circuit expressivity
2. Grouping second-block RY gates by parity (all even, then all odd) hurts convergence vs alternating pattern
3. Slow convergence (480 steps) and low worst_group_margin (0.32) indicate poor optimization

The solution restores:
- RZ mid-layer with shared parameter "rz_mid" for all qubits (adds 1 param)
- Alternating RY pattern in second block (ry_even, ry_odd, ry_even, ry_odd on wires 0-7) instead of grouped pattern
- Keep rz_pre_even/rz_pre_odd split to maintain parameter efficiency while fixing expressivity

This mirrors the successful first prior structure which achieved 0.58 with 12 distinct params and proper robustness margins.
